newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 unchanged, latex firm.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 unchanged, latex firm.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were unchanged in slow late trading on Monday, while sentiment on latex remained firm, dealers said.

"This is one of the worst times that I've ever known. There are very few people who have secured a deal since early last week on the back of continued tight supply," one SIR20 dealer in the western Sumatran city of Padang said.

Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for October/November were at 56.00-56.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and at 55.75-56.25 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang, and at 55.25-55.75 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
There were no fresh latex deals heard, but sentiment was firm following the loading of some 2,000 tonnes of latex in Medan late last week.
High amoniac grade latex with 60 percent dry rubber content was last traded at 2,230 rupiah/kg against the previous 2,250 rupiah in Bandung and Tangerang, dealers said.
